title: Effect of Smoking on the Expression of Gelatinases in Chronic Periodontitis
brief_summary: This study comparatively evaluate the expressions of MMP-2 and MMP-9 in smoker vs non-smoker chronic periodontitis patients as well as periodontally healthy subjects. the hypothesis of this study was that smoking may interfere with periodontal disease by effecting MMP-2 and MMP-9 expressions.
study_population: A total of 80 subjects (35 females, 45 males, with an age range of 16-62 years) were included in this study from those patients seeking dental treatment at the Baskent University School of Dentistry
